act.long_title: An Act to consolidate and amend the provisions relating to offences and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.

classification.offence: Wrongfully concealing or keeping in confinement, kidnapped or abducted person.
classification.triable_by: Court by which the kidnapping or abduction is triable.

section.heading: Wrongfully concealing or keeping in confinement, kidnapped or abducted person
section.html: Whoever, knowing that any person has been kidnapped or has been abducted, wrongfully conceals or confines such person, shall be punished in the same manner as if he had kidnapped or abducted such person with the same intention or knowledge, or for the same purpose as that with or for which he conceals or detains such person in confinement.
section.text: Whoever, knowing that any person has been kidnapped or has been abducted, wrongfully conceals or confines such person, shall be punished in the same manner as if he had kidnapped or abducted such person with the same intention or knowledge, or for the same purpose as that with or for which he conceals or detains such person in confinement.
